turns.content: I've finally started properly tracking my spending. I'm shocked by how much I was spending on takeaways.
Tracking is the first step and the results are always eye-opening. What tool are you using?
Just a spreadsheet for now. I might try an app but I like seeing it laid out simply.
Spreadsheets work well for people who want full control. Have you set any savings targets?
I want to build up a three-month emergency fund. I have about one month saved currently.
Three months is a solid target. Even small consistent transfers to a separate account make it feel less abstract.
I've set up an automatic transfer on payday so I never see the money in my current account.
Automating it is the most effective approach — it removes the decision from the equation entirely.
